# Magog

## Overview

- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_

## Appearance

Magog is a china dog crafted to look toward the left. Its exterior features a gleaming coat colored in white and green.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 3 THE LAND OF DREAMS AMONG P55](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0055), [v4 CHAPTER 29 GILBERT AND ANNE DISAGREE P1](../source/v04-c29.md#nw-v04-c29-p0001)_

## History

Magog is a china dog who looks to the left and originally presided over the hearth at Patty's Place alongside [Gog](../character/gog.md). Captain Jim took a great fancy to Magog and [Gog](../character/gog.md) during his acquaintance with [Anne](../character/anne.md). Magog subsequently presided over the destinies of the hearth in [Anne](../character/anne.md) and Gilbert's little house with dignity and aplomb.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Place P3](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0003), [v3 ch.Place P4](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0004), [v3 ch.Place P5](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0005), [v3 ch.Place P6](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0006), [v3 ch.Place P7](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0007), [v3 ch.Place P9](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0009), +228 more_
